post.description:
Upload a file (multipart field `file`) for preview and import. The body is streamed to
disk; files over `max_upload_mb` are refused from `Content-Length` before reading.
Unknown extensions (and files without one) are 415 unless `kind` is given; `.txt` is
read as CSV. A `kind` given here is remembered, so preview and import needn't repeat it.

post.description:
Exact descriptive statistics; `values.summaries` is a list of FieldSummary.

The source may be a dataset or a pipeline (with `pipelines` holding every pipeline it
reaches, unsaved edits included).

Correlation matrix; `values` is CorrelationValues. Pearson is exact; Spearman and
Kendall run on a sample when the data are large.

Linear or multiple OLS regression (sampled above 1M rows); `values` is
RegressionValues.
One-sample, Welch, Student or paired t-test (exact); `values` is TTestValues.

Mann-Whitney U, Wilcoxon signed-rank or Kruskal-Wallis test; `values` is
RankTestValues.
One- or two-way ANOVA (exact); `values` is AnovaValues.

Chi-square test of independence or goodness of fit (exact counts); `values` is
ChiSquareValues.

Maximum-likelihood distribution fits ranked by AIC; `values` is
DistributionFitValues.

Outliers by IQR fences, z-scores or modified z-scores (exact); `values` is
OutlierValues.
Confidence intervals (t or bootstrap); `values` is ConfidenceIntervalValues.

AnovaRequest.title: AnovaRequest
AnovaRequest.description: One- or two-way ANOVA of `field`, exact on the full data (from per-cell aggregates).

ChannelInfo.title: ChannelInfo
ChannelInfo.description: A channel a plot's server module validates. Server-produced.

ChartTemplate.title: ChartTemplate
ChartTemplate.description: A reusable style preset applied to charts.

ChiSquareRequest.title: ChiSquareRequest
ChiSquareRequest.description:
Pearson's chi-square on counts computed in SQL.

- independence: `field` x `column_field` contingency table
- goodness_of_fit: counts of `field` vs `expected` proportions (uniform when omitted)

ColumnValues.title: ColumnValues
ColumnValues.description: Distinct values with counts, for filter dropdowns. Server-produced.

ConfidenceIntervalRequest.title: ConfidenceIntervalRequest
ConfidenceIntervalRequest.description:
Confidence intervals; estimates are exact on all values.

`auto`: t for the mean, order statistics (distribution-free) for the median and
quantiles, and for the SD the bootstrap up to 10,000 values per group and the
kurtosis-adjusted asymptotic interval above. `bootstrap` bootstraps groups of up to
10,000 values (all of them, never a subsample) and uses the statistic's exact interval
above. `t` is for the mean only.

CorrelationRequest.title: CorrelationRequest
CorrelationRequest.description: Correlation matrix of numeric fields (booleans count 0/1, dates count days).

DistributionFitRequest.title: DistributionFitRequest
DistributionFitRequest.description: Maximum-likelihood fits of continuous distributions, ranked by AIC (on a sample).

Encoding.title: Encoding
Encoding.description: One field bound to a channel. `field` may be None only for count(*).

ImportFromPathRequest.title: ImportFromPathRequest
ImportFromPathRequest.description: Local mode only: read a file in place instead of uploading it.

ImportOptions.title: ImportOptions
ImportOptions.description: Overrides for auto-detection. Leave a field unset to let the reader detect it.

InPredicate.title: InPredicate
InPredicate.description:
Membership. `None` in `values` matches NULL. `not_in` keeps NULL rows unless `None` is
in `values`, so excluding "North" never silently drops rows with a missing region.

Job.title: Job
Job.description: Server-produced. Each SSE event carries a full snapshot.

LayoutItem.title: LayoutItem
LayoutItem.description: One widget placed on the 12-column grid (react-grid-layout units).

OutlierRequest.title: OutlierRequest
OutlierRequest.description:
Outliers by Tukey's fences (iqr), z-scores or modified z-scores (mad), exact in SQL.

A value is an outlier when |score| > threshold; defaults are 1.5 (iqr), 3 (zscore) and
3.5 (mad, Iglewicz-Hoaglin).

OverlayResult.title: OverlayResult
OverlayResult.description: A server-computed trendline or regression fit, with an optional band. Server-produced.

ProjectImportResult.title: ProjectImportResult
ProjectImportResult.description: Server-produced only, so every field is required.

RangePredicate.title: RangePredicate
RangePredicate.description: Numeric range, or date range when op is `between_dates`. A missing bound is open.

RankTestRequest.title: RankTestRequest
RankTestRequest.description:
Rank-based tests (SciPy, on a sample above 1M rows).

- mann_whitney: `field` in groups[0] vs groups[1] of `group_field`
- wilcoxon: signed-rank test of `field - paired_field` (or of `field - mu` without a
  paired field)
- kruskal: `field` across the groups of `group_field` (`groups` picks a subset)

RegressionRequest.title: RegressionRequest
RegressionRequest.description: OLS of `y` on `x`: numeric, boolean (0/1), date (days) or categorical (dummies).

SeriesStyle.title: SeriesStyle
SeriesStyle.description: Per-series overrides, keyed by index into the y channel.

SortKey.title: SortKey
SortKey.description: One sort key, shared by the sort step, grid rows, pipeline previews and exports.

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description: Points at the data a chart, pipeline step or widget reads.

StagedFile.title: StagedFile
StagedFile.description: An uploaded file waiting to be previewed and imported. Server-produced.

TTestRequest.title: TTestRequest
TTestRequest.description:
t-tests, exact on the full data (they need only counts, means and variances).

- one_sample: mean of `field` vs `mu`
- welch / student: `field` in groups[0] vs groups[1] of `group_field` (difference a - b)
- paired: mean of `field - paired_field` vs `mu`, over rows where both are present

Trendline.title: Trendline
Trendline.description: A server-computed overlay fitted to one y series.

AssumptionCheck.description: An assumption check that ran (or couldn't) alongside a test. Server-produced.
AssumptionCheck.title: AssumptionCheck

ChartDataMeta.description: Server-produced only, so every field is required (and non-optional in TypeScript).
ChartDataMeta.title: ChartDataMeta

ChartStatResponse.description: JSON body of /api/charts/data for plots that use a stat transform. Server-produced.
ChartStatResponse.title: ChartStatResponse

FieldSummary.description: One field within one group of a descriptive-statistics table. Server-produced.
FieldSummary.title: FieldSummary

ImportPreviewMeta.description: Arrow metadata of a preview response. Server-produced.
ImportPreviewMeta.title: ImportPreviewMeta

PipelinePreviewMeta.description: Server-produced; travels as viz.meta in the Arrow schema.
PipelinePreviewMeta.title: PipelinePreviewMeta

SampleSummary.description: n, mean and spread of one sample or group. Server-produced.
SampleSummary.title: SampleSummary

StatsSourceRequest.description: Common part of every statistics request: the data and the filters on it.
StatsSourceRequest.title: StatsSourceRequest
